name: Lesha Cheda
title: Finally my curls behave!
text: I have been chasing the curly girl method for years and this is the first cream that actually defined my 3B curls without leaving them crunchy. Two pumps on wet hair, scrunch, air-dry — magic.

name: Deepika Patel
title: Volume that lasts 3 days
text: The hydrating gel gives me lift at the roots that I never thought possible. I refresh on day 3 and curls still pop. Plus the smell is so subtle and pretty.

name: Riya Sharma
title: Perfect for my 2C waves
text: Most curl creams weigh down my hair. This one defines my waves softly and doesn't make them stringy. Light, hydrating, no crunch.

name: Anaya Krishnan
title: Gentle and effective
text: Finally a sulphate-free shampoo that actually cleanses without stripping. My scalp feels clean, curls feel hydrated.

name: Meera Joshi
title: Game changer
text: I was a cotton-towel-trauma victim. This microfiber towel cut my drying time in half and frizz by 80%. Plotted with the bonnet, it's a dream.

name: Saanvi Mehta
title: The full routine works
text: Bought the Curly Glow Routine and never looked back. Defined, bouncy, shiny curls — exactly what the brand promises.

name: Tanya Iyer
title: Pure shine, zero grease
text: Three drops on dry curls and they look glassy without being oily. Smells beautiful too.

name: Pooja Reddy
title: Slip is unreal
text: This conditioner detangles in 30 seconds. My fingers glide right through. Love using a tiny bit as leave-in too.

name: Aditi Roy
title: Curls survive sleep
text: Wake up with curls intact. The bonnet is soft, fits well and ribbon doesn't loosen at night.

name: Ishita Bose
title: My holy grail gel
text: I have 3C curls and this gel gives me the cleanest definition. Cast scrunches out into the softest curls.

name: Niyati Kapoor
title: Defined for 3 days
text: Strong hold but never crunchy. My curls last 3 wash days and refresh easily.

name: Avani Singh
title: Best for waves
text: As a 2B I struggled to find products that didn't weigh me down. The Wavy Glow Routine is everything. Soft, hydrated, defined.

name: Kavya Nair
title: Lightweight magic
text: Use it as a primer before cream + gel. Doesn't get heavy, adds slip and hydration.

name: Sneha Pillai
title: No more breakage
text: Brushes through my soaking wet 3A curls without snapping a single strand. Highly recommend.

name: Vrinda Bhatt
title: Smooth hair, glowing skin
text: Two-in-one. Hair stays defined, skin feels softer. Wish I had bought it sooner.
